part.text:
Fixed. The embedded image render hook template ignored markdown attributes (`{.foo}` → `class="foo"`). The fix is a one-line change in `tpl/tplimpl/embedded/templates/_default/_markup/render-image.html:8`, matching upstream Hugo:

```go-html-template
{{- $attributes := merge .Attributes (dict "alt" .Text "src" $src "title" .Title) -}}
```

`merge` gives precedence to the leftmost map, so `alt`/`src`/`title` keep their computed values while any markdown-provided attributes (e.g. `class`, `id`) are added.

Verified:
- `TestEmbeddedImageRenderHookMarkdownAttributes` (tpl/tplimpl) now passes
- `./tpl/tplimpl/...`, `./markup/...`, `./tpl/images/...`, `./tpl/collections/...`, `./publisher/...` all pass (the only failure was a network timeout downloading `leaktest` in `hugolib`, unrelated to the change)
